## My account

Sign in or create account

Boston Scientific accounts are for healthcare professionals only.

Create an account to access online training and education on EDUCARE, manage your customer profile,
and connect with customer support and service teams.

My Boston Scientific account

Access your online applications and manage your customer profile.

[Manage my Boston Scientific account][147]

## Featured stories

[heart arteries showing implantation of Boston Scientific stunt.]

Patients and innovation

### **3 cutting-edge cancer therapies**

These treatments destroy tumors, lessen side effects and reduce pain.

[Learn how they work][158]
[Boston Scientific employees signs a Boston Scientific quality wall.]

Corporate responsibility

### How we ensure product and patient safety

At Boston Scientific, every employee plays a role in transforming lives.

[See how we create a culture of quality][159]
[Two smiling woman and a man looking toward camera while holding certificate.]

Team and culture

### **Helping our employees grow**

Our award-winning career development program teaches skills for work – and life.

[Meet two graduates][160]
[q1 26 earnings thumbnail.]

Company news

### **Interested in our latest financial results?**

Learn about our first-quarter performance.

[View the results here][161]

### We advance science for life

At Boston Scientific, we are driven to help patients experience more – more dancing, more playing,
more celebrating, more living.

## Explore Boston Scientific

[Smiling Boston Scientific employees at conference table.]

Careers

### Grow your career at Boston Scientific

Come help us transform lives by working at the forefront of medical innovation.

[Search for jobs][162]
[Boston Scientific CEO Mike Mahoney smiling in front of Boston Scientific sign.]

Investor Relations

### Information for investors and shareholders

Check our quarterly earnings reports, find out about upcoming presentations and more.

[View our financial performance][163]
[Young girl in Boston scientific community tshirt and holding plant in her hand.]

Corporate Responsibility

### Acting on our mission to improve the health of patients around the world

We are advancing science for more innovative care, empowered people and a healthier planet.

[Explore our latest impact reporting][164]

Boston Scientific is dedicated to transforming lives through innovative medical solutions that
improve the health of patients around the world.

## About Hologic

Hologic helps women around the world live healthier lives.

We develop innovative medical technologies that effectively detect, diagnose and treat health
conditions and raise the standard of care globally.

We know women face unique health challenges at every stage of life, and we are passionate about
being a force for good.

Hologic is propelled by the passion and courage of our people to make a difference and innovate in
all we do. We believe everyone should feel welcomed, valued and heard, because great ideas come from

  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

Healthcare Professionals

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

Innovation without collaboration isn't enough. We work closely with healthcare professionals to
introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

[ Read more ][180]

1. Slide 1

Our impact

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]
[------------------]

Careers

 

## Join the team that powers the extraordinary

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

Home

Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

Healthcare Professionals

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

Innovation without collaboration isn't enough. We work closely with healthcare professionals to
introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

[ Read more ][180]

Our impact

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]
[------------------]

Careers

 

## Join the team that powers the extraordinary

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Transforming lives

Learn how our history and our passion drive us to strengthen, accelerate and transform the future of
medical technology

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

At Advin, we are dedicated to transforming healthcare through innovation, precision, and quality. As
a leading manufacturer of medical devices, we focus on delivering advanced solutions that enhance
patient outcomes and empower healthcare professionals worldwide. Our commitment to excellence drives
us to create reliable, safe, and cutting-edge devices designed to meet the evolving needs of modern
healthcare systems. [Read More>>][134]

Advin Manufacturing Facility
Advin Health Care’s five-story, 50,000+ sq. ft. facility is built for precision-driven medical
equipment manufacturing. With dedicated floors for R&D, assembly, testing, and packaging, it ensures
streamlined, high-quality production. Cleanroom environments and global standard compliance
highlight Advin’s commitment to innovation and healthcare excellence.
Advin Corporate House

Advin Health Care’s three-story, 9,000+ sq. ft. corporate house serves as the strategic hub for its
global operations. Designed for collaboration and innovation, it embodies a modern, professional
environment. The workspace reflects Advin’s vision of leadership and excellence in the healthcare
industry.

Advin Storage Facility

Advin's 35,000+ sq. ft. central storage godown is designed with automated systems and structured
workflows to handle high-volume medical products with speed, accuracy, and efficiency. Automated
handling, digital inventory control, and clearly defined storage zones ensure product safety,
traceability, and consistent quality.

Our logistics operations are powered by automation-driven packing, labeling, and documentation
processes, enabling fast, accurate, and compliant dispatch to domestic and international markets.

This advanced storage and dispatch facility reflects our commitment to precision, scalability, and
reliability—supporting uninterrupted supply and customer confidence worldwide.

the prestigious “Star Export House” certification.

# Laser-Focused
# Engineering™

Since 1983, CMS Laser has been designing and building turnkey laser material processing systems for
marking, cutting, drilling, welding, and more. Our cutting-edge laser systems are expertly
engineered for high-precision applications in a wide range of industries. All our machines are
proudly designed and built in the USA, tailored to each clients’ unique manufacturing needs.

[Get Started][32]

## Custom Laser Solutions

[

#### Products

][33] [

#### Capabilities

][34] [

#### Techniques

][35]

## We Build Laser Machines for Manufacturers Worldwide

Our comprehensive range of solutions encompasses a variety of laser machines, ranging from basic
models to fully automated laser processing systems. Each machine we build is designed and expertly
supported by our team of skilled engineers. While we specialize in crafting industrial laser
solutions to enhance manufacturing efficiency, it’s important to note that we do not offer laser
material processing services for customer parts. Whether your needs involve laser marking and
engraving machines or cutting and welding systems, our focus remains on providing innovative
industrial laser solutions that empower manufacturers to operate at their best.

[Our Capabilities][36]

### Laser Material Processing Automation

Whether you need a laser machine to mark, engrave, cut, drill or weld, our systems can be
fully-automated utilizing machine vision, custom handling and software. Turnkey, ready to run at
your facility.

[Laser Techniques ][37]

### High-Tech Turnkey Solutions

From basic laser marking technologies to advanced material processing machines for welding intricate
parts or drilling thin metals, our solutions are carefully designed to meet or exceed your goals.

[Advanced Capabilities ][38]

### Applications Expertise

With over 40 years of business, our laser applications lab can determine if your desired process is
feasible. Laser mark, cut, drill, weld and more!

[Applications Development ][39]

## Our Laser Machine Building Process

#### Step 1: Applications Testing

Client materials are sent through our applications development lab for analysis. This is where we
determine the optimal laser, optics, and motion control components before delivering a formal quote
and system design. This step is crucial to understanding if your desired process is feasible before
moving onto system design.

#### Step 2: System Design

If one of our standard solutions does not work, our engineers will design and build a system to meet
your manufacturing requirements from step one. From basic laser marking systems to fully automated
solutions, our engineers are a part of your team.

#### Step 3: Testing

During final assembly, we thoroughly test the machine to ensure all systems are working to spec
while openly communicating with the client to fine tune their process. We provide progress demo
videos, full training, and virtual/in-person factory acceptance testing (FAT). Once the machine is
completed, it is shipped off to your facility and ready for installation.

# Laser-Focused
# Engineering™

Since 1983, CMS Laser has been designing and building turnkey laser material processing systems for
marking, cutting, drilling, welding, and more. Our cutting-edge laser systems are expertly
engineered for high-precision applications in a wide range of industries. All our machines are
proudly designed and built in the USA, tailored to each clients’ unique manufacturing needs.

[Get Started][32]

## Custom Laser Solutions

[

#### Products

][33] [

#### Capabilities

][34] [

#### Techniques

][35]

## We Build Laser Machines for Manufacturers Worldwide

Our comprehensive range of solutions encompasses a variety of laser machines, ranging from basic
models to fully automated laser processing systems. Each machine we build is designed and expertly
supported by our team of skilled engineers. While we specialize in crafting industrial laser
solutions to enhance manufacturing efficiency, it’s important to note that we do not offer laser
material processing services for customer parts. Whether your needs involve laser marking and
engraving machines or cutting and welding systems, our focus remains on providing innovative
industrial laser solutions that empower manufacturers to operate at their best.

[Our Capabilities][36]

### Laser Material Processing Automation

Whether you need a laser machine to mark, engrave, cut, drill or weld, our systems can be
fully-automated utilizing machine vision, custom handling and software. Turnkey, ready to run at
your facility.

[Laser Techniques ][37]

### High-Tech Turnkey Solutions

From basic laser marking technologies to advanced material processing machines for welding intricate
parts or drilling thin metals, our solutions are carefully designed to meet or exceed your goals.

[Advanced Capabilities ][38]

### Applications Expertise

With over 40 years of business, our laser applications lab can determine if your desired process is
feasible. Laser mark, cut, drill, weld and more!

[Applications Development ][39]

## Our Laser Machine Building Process

#### Step 1: Applications Testing

Client materials are sent through our applications development lab for analysis. This is where we
determine the optimal laser, optics, and motion control components before delivering a formal quote
and system design. This step is crucial to understanding if your desired process is feasible before
moving onto system design.

#### Step 2: System Design

If one of our standard solutions does not work, our engineers will design and build a system to meet
your manufacturing requirements from step one. From basic laser marking systems to fully automated
solutions, our engineers are a part of your team.

#### Step 3: Testing

During final assembly, we thoroughly test the machine to ensure all systems are working to spec
while openly communicating with the client to fine tune their process. We provide progress demo
videos, full training, and virtual/in-person factory acceptance testing (FAT). Once the machine is
completed, it is shipped off to your facility and ready for installation.

Excellent Equipment.

Global Endoscopy Solutions provides medical equipment in like new condition for a fraction of the
cost from the OEM. Our staff of highly skilled technicians perform outstanding quality repairs that
last and our customer service is second to none in the industry.

# Welcome to Global Endoscopy

Your Source
For Endoscopy Equipment & Service

Global Endoscopy Solutions, Inc. is a leader in both the sale of [high quality pre-owned endoscopy
equipment ][49]as well as maintaining, [repairing][50], and refurbishing your existing equipment to
like new condition. We provide quality [pre-owned endoscopy equipment][51] from manufacturers such
as Olympus and Pentax . With our state of the art, fully ESD compliant repair facility, we are truly
a one stop shop for all of your endoscopy needs.

Global Endoscopy Solutions, Inc. is proud to offer an 18-Month Warranty on all endoscopes,
[processors][52], [light sources][53], etc. We also offer the longest repair warranty in the
business, 12 months! It is with confidence that we offer this high level of warranty coverage on the
electronics as well as the endoscopes. In addition, we are also offering a full 7-Day Satisfaction
Guarantee or your money back. No restocking fees!! Just simply return the equipment to us in the
same condition you received it. We just ask that you give us an opportunity to correct any issues
that may arise. We provide a good quality product and [repair service][54], backup it up with the
best warranty in the business, and do so at very economical prices.

It is our mission, to acquire endoscopes, processors, light sources, and accessories from hospitals,
private practices, surgery centers, etc, and perform the necessary repairs and refurbishment so that
we are able to resell as like new and fully warranted. All endoscopy equipment is thoroughly
inspected, and if necessary, repaired and refurbished to ensure that they meet or exceed OEM
specifications.

[doctor holding endoscope][doctor holding endoscope]

By providing excellent customer service, standing behind everything we do, and having honesty &
integrity as the pillars of our being, we can say with no doubt, that we will meet and exceed your
expectations. We look forward to being able to provide you with excellent service.

#### IE’s goal is to be...

# The Wireless Arthroscopy Company

At Integrated Endoscopy, our main goal is to revolutionize wireless arthroscopic technology. We’re
dedicated to leading the way in meeting the growing demand for advanced solutions.

[Watch Video][36] [Learn More][37]
[
NUVIS™ Scope
][38]
[
Wireless Camera
][39]
[
NUVIS™ Stack
][40]
[
Wireless Shaver
][41]
[
Arthroscopy Pump
][42]

## What Do We Do?

Integrated Endoscopy is a pioneer in the development of high-quality, low-cost single-use rigid
endoscopes. Its NUVIS Single-Use Arthroscope is revolutionizing the endoscopy market by delivering
high-definition optics in a single-use device—providing first-time quality for every procedure.

[View Latest News][43]

## Single-Use

Single-use NUVIS is a surgical device that addresses the many issues of conventional reusable
arthroscopes.

[Learn More][44]

## 24 x 7

NUVIS is your backup arthroscope, eliminating the need for replacements in critical moments.

[Learn More][45]

## Safety First

Sterile-packaged NUVIS prevents infection, protecting patients and institutions from processing
errors.

[Learn More][46]

## Coolite™ LED

38˚C LED offers cordless, cool white light, preventing ‘tip burn’, no external light source or
cables needed.

[Learn More][47]

## Eliminate Repairs

Reliably consistent, immune to wear, ensures clinical performance regardless of setting.

[Learn More][48]

## Clean Up The Mess

Battery power removes cable clutter and reduces contamination risk in operating rooms.

[Learn More][49]

## Performance

HD quality like traditional scopes, single-use design using smartphone camera tech.

[Learn More][50]

## Save Big

Single-use device, eliminates ongoing costs tied to cleaning, sterilizing, inventory, downtime, and
repairs.

[Learn More][51]

## What's New?

[Integrated Endoscopy and Intelliscopes Announce Strategic Alliance][52]
March 7, 2025
[IE Announces Commercial Release of Nuvis Wireless Camera System for International Markets][53]
July 23, 2024
[ESSKA 2024 – Milan, Italy][54]
May 10, 2024
[See IE at ESSKA 2024 in Milan, Italy – May 8-10][55]
April 19, 2024
[See Us @ AAOS 2024 in San Francisco, Feb. 12-16][56]
February 6, 2024
[Integrated Endoscopy Partners with Frii Medical to Market Wireless, Single-Use Shaver System][57]
January 24, 2024
[Integrated Endoscopy Announces the Global Launch of Gen II NUVIS Single-Use, 4K, Battery Operated
Cordless Arthroscope][58]
November 3, 2022
[Integrated Endoscopy Initiates Worldwide Pilot Launch of NUVIS Single-Use, HD, Battery Operated
Arthroscope][59]
November 4, 2019

### Dr. Akizuki, San Francisco Giants Team Physician, Demonstrates NUVIS Scope's Capabilities in
### Arthroscopy

Thrilled to showcase Dr. Akizuki, MD, the esteemed team physician of the [San Francisco Giants][60],
highlighting the capabilities of the NUVIS Scope in an arthroscopic procedure.

Dr. Akizuki commented:

“The video on this is impeccable – you can’t tell the difference between a traditional scope… and
it’s wireless! Which to all of us orthopedists… is a dream come true!”

[View on LinkedIn][61]

### Wireless Disposable Arthroscope NUVIS Debuts in Brazil with Successful Procedure at Sapopemba
### State Hospital

I.E. through its local distributor, FAM Medic, performed the first procedure in Brazil with its
wireless disposable arthroscope – NUVIS. Dr. Alexandre Pailo and Dr. Marco Negrelli performed ACL
reconstruction at Sapopemba State Hospital.

Dr. Negrelli commented:

“Revolutionary device with excellent image quality, ergonomic, lightweight, and without cables that
hinder the procedure. And disposable! With the NUVIS, there is no risk of cross-infection or the
possibility of the optics being damaged or scratched. We will always support the launch of new,
high-quality technologies, such as NUVIS. Hope to have more new technologies soon!”

[View on LinkedIn][62]

# Contact Sales

Contact us to get in touch with a distributor near you!

## What Do We Do?

endoscopes. Its NUVIS Single-Use Arthroscope is revolutionizing the endoscopy market by delivering
high-definition optics in a single-use device—providing first-time quality for every procedure.

## Single-Use

Single-use NUVIS is a surgical device that addresses the many issues of conventional reusable
arthroscopes.

[Learn More][44]

## 24 x 7

NUVIS is your backup arthroscope, eliminating the need for replacements in critical moments.

[Learn More][45]

## Safety First

Sterile-packaged NUVIS prevents infection, protecting patients and institutions from processing
errors.

[Learn More][46]

## Coolite™ LED

38˚C LED offers cordless, cool white light, preventing ‘tip burn’, no external light source or
cables needed.

[Learn More][47]

Reliably consistent, immune to wear, ensures clinical performance regardless of setting.

[Learn More][48]

Battery power removes cable clutter and reduces contamination risk in operating rooms.

[Learn More][49]

## Performance

HD quality like traditional scopes, single-use design using smartphone camera tech.

[Learn More][50]

## Save Big

Single-use device, eliminates ongoing costs tied to cleaning, sterilizing, inventory, downtime, and
repairs.

elsewhere.

## of mdma

### Leadership

Saved industry jobs and over $30B with device tax repeal

### Mission

Accelerating patient access and improving health outcomes

### Network

Hundreds of companies of all sizes championing MedTech innovation

“As our organization grows and seeks to continue improving patient care, MDMA has been the perfect
partner to help our team overcome regulatory and reimbursement challenges throughout the years.”

Laura Francis | Chief Executive Officer, SI-BONE

“As a past CEO of multiple companies over the years, MDMA has always been a great resource and
valuable partner in our efforts to improve patient outcomes.”

Doug Godshall | Chairman of the Board of Directors, Saluda Medical & Executive Chairman, Galvanize
Therapeutics

“I have been fortunate to lead both large and small companies, and no matter what policy challenges
they faced, I would always want MDMA to be our voice, advocate and partner. The active engagement
with MDMA and collaboration with fellow members is essential for companies of all sizes to improve
patient care and the innovation ecosystem.”

James (Jim) V. Mazzo | Executive Chairman, Neurotech

## of mdma

### Leadership

Saved industry jobs and over $30B with device tax repeal

### Mission

Accelerating patient access and improving health outcomes

### Network

Hundreds of companies of all sizes championing MedTech innovation

“As our organization grows and seeks to continue improving patient care, MDMA has been the perfect
partner to help our team overcome regulatory and reimbursement challenges throughout the years.”

Laura Francis | Chief Executive Officer, SI-BONE

“As a past CEO of multiple companies over the years, MDMA has always been a great resource and
valuable partner in our efforts to improve patient outcomes.”

Doug Godshall | Chairman of the Board of Directors, Saluda Medical & Executive Chairman, Galvanize
Therapeutics

“I have been fortunate to lead both large and small companies, and no matter what policy challenges
they faced, I would always want MDMA to be our voice, advocate and partner. The active engagement
with MDMA and collaboration with fellow members is essential for companies of all sizes to improve
patient care and the innovation ecosystem.”

James (Jim) V. Mazzo | Executive Chairman, Neurotech

the network and resources of MDMA to make your voice heard in Washington, DC and beyond!

## Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about Patient Notes AI

### What is Patient Notes AI?

Patient Notes AI is an AI-powered medical scribe that listens to your patient encounters,
transcribes them, and automatically generates structured clinical documentation like SOAP notes,
progress notes, and more.

### How does Patient Notes work?

Simply record your patient encounter using our iOS app or web interface. Our AI listens to the
conversation, creates an accurate transcription, and then generates properly formatted clinical
notes based on your customizable templates.

### What note formats are supported?

We support SOAP notes, progress notes, H&P notes, procedure notes, and fully customizable templates.
You can create templates for different visit types, specialties, or specific workflows.

### Can I customize templates?

Yes, you can fully customize note templates to match your specialty and documentation preferences.
Create templates for different visit types, specialties, or specific workflows.

### Is there an iOS app available?

Yes, Patient Notes is available as a native iOS app for iPhone and iPad, making it easy to record
patient encounters on the go. A web interface is also available for desktop use.

# Welcome to SteelcoBelimed

## Innovate with confidence

True to our claim – “innovate with confidence” – we lead the way in advanced cleaning and
sterilization solutions for the healthcare, laboratory, and pharma industries.
Relentless innovation, utmost reliability, and an unmatched commitment to customer satisfaction make
us the ideal partner in providing tailored end-to-end sterile workflow solutions.

## Solutions

## Healthcare

## Healthcare

As a leading infection control solution provider, SteelcoBelimed develops, manufactures, and
supplies solutions for the cleaning, disinfection, and sterilization of medical devices that
maximize safety, optimize processes and minimize costs.

A tailor-made selection of state-of-the-art equipment and components, advanced technical solutions,
and automation integration guarantees workflow optimization, maximum efficiency, and reliable
results.
[ Discover more ][84]

## Lab & Research

## Lab & Research

SteelcoBelimed's experience and understanding of the laboratory workflow - from the smallest
facility to the largest scientific research center - enable us to offer the safest and most
cost-effective solutions for your staff, instruments, and animals.

Our cleaning and sterilization solutions are recognized for their design, reliability, ergonomics,
quality, operator safety, and allergens protection.
[ Discover more ][85]

## Pharma & Med Tech

environments.

Driven by innovation and customer focus, we help you enhance performance, ensure compliance, and
improve operational efficiency every day.

## FAQ

### What is rhinoplasty surgery?

Rhinoplasty is a surgical procedure to reshape or repair the nose for cosmetic reasons or to improve
nasal function (e.g., breathing). It may involve altering the bone, cartilage, or skin of the nose.

### What are the main types of instruments used in rhinoplasty?

The main types of instruments used in rhinoplasty include:
* **Scalpels** (for making precise incisions),
* **Rongeurs** (for removing bone or cartilage),
* **Osteotomes** (for shaping bones),
* **Elevators** (for lifting tissues),
* **Forceps** (for grasping tissues),
* **Rasp** (for smoothing the nasal bone),
* **Cautery devices** (to stop bleeding),
* **Sutures** (for closing incisions).

### Why are osteotomes used in rhinoplasty?

Osteotomes are chisel-like instruments used to cut, reshape, or remove bone during rhinoplasty. They
are particularly useful when adjusting the shape of the nasal bones, such as narrowing the nose or
realigning the bones after a break.

### What is the purpose of nasal splints in rhinoplasty?

Nasal splints are applied after surgery to provide support and protect the nose during healing. They
help maintain the newly reshaped structure and reduce swelling while promoting proper healing.

### How are sutures used in rhinoplasty?

Sutures are used to close the incisions made during surgery. They can be either dissolvable
(absorbed by the body over time) or non-dissolvable (requiring removal after a few days). They
ensure the wound stays closed while healing occurs.

### What is the role of forceps in rhinoplasty?

Forceps are used to grasp or hold tissues, cartilage, or other structures during the surgery. Their
precision allows the surgeon to manipulate delicate areas without causing damage to the surrounding
tissue.

### Why is a surgical scalpel important in rhinoplasty?

A scalpel is essential for making precise, clean incisions that allow the surgeon to access the
nasal bones, cartilage, and skin without unnecessary trauma to the surrounding tissues. It ensures
minimal scarring.

### How does a rasp work in rhinoplasty?

A rasp is a tool used to smooth and shape the nasal bones after they have been cut or reshaped. It
works like a file, gently filing down rough edges and contouring the bone to achieve a smoother,
more aesthetically pleasing nose shape.

* **Cautery devices** (to stop bleeding),
* **Sutures** (for closing incisions).

### What is the role of forceps in rhinoplasty?

tissue.

### Why is a surgical scalpel important in rhinoplasty?

blood loss and helps maintain a clear surgical field, which is important for precision and safety.

### How does a speculum aid in rhinoplasty surgery?

view and access to the nasal cavity during surgery. It helps in visualizing internal nasal
structures for precise adjustments.

### What is the function of a surgical rongeur in rhinoplasty?

A rongeur is used for removing or trimming bone or cartilage. It has sharp, curved jaws that help
with cutting and shaping structures, especially when reducing or sculpting the nasal bones during
the procedure.

### Are there any special instruments for cartilage grafting in rhinoplasty?

Yes, special instruments are used for cartilage grafting. These tools help shape and implant
cartilage from other areas (e.g., the septum, ear, or rib) to provide structural support or enhance
the nasal appearance. They are used to carefully harvest and place the grafts.

### How long does it take to complete a rhinoplasty procedure?

The length of a rhinoplasty surgery can vary depending on the complexity of the procedure. On
average, it takes about 1.5 to 3 hours, though it may take longer if additional procedures, such as
cartilage grafting or septoplasty, are involved.

### Why is surgical suction necessary during rhinoplasty?

Surgical suction is used to remove blood, fluids, or debris from the surgical area. This ensures the
surgeon has a clear view of the nasal structures, which is crucial for precise and safe surgery.

### What kind of aftercare is required after rhinoplasty?

After rhinoplasty, patients typically need to rest and avoid any strenuous activities for several
weeks. Nasal packing or splints may be used temporarily, and follow-up appointments are important to
monitor healing. Swelling and bruising are common, and pain management is part of post-operative
care.

### Are there risks involved with using surgical instruments in rhinoplasty?

As with any surgery, there are potential risks, including infection, scarring, excessive bleeding,
or damage to the nasal structures. However, skilled surgeons use these instruments with great care,
and complications are rare when proper procedures are followed.

### Do all surgeons use the same instruments for rhinoplasty?

Most surgeons use a similar set of instruments, but there may be slight variations depending on the
surgeon’s preferences, the type of rhinoplasty (open vs. closed), and the complexity of the
procedure. Some surgeons may also use advanced technology like endoscopes in specific cases.

* **Cautery devices** (to stop bleeding),
* **Sutures** (for closing incisions).

(absorbed by the body over time) or non-dissolvable (requiring removal after a few days). They
ensure the wound stays closed while healing occurs.

### What is the role of forceps in rhinoplasty?

precision allows the surgeon to manipulate delicate areas without causing damage to the surrounding
tissue.

### Why is a surgical scalpel important in rhinoplasty?

nasal bones, cartilage, and skin without unnecessary trauma to the surrounding tissues. It ensures
minimal scarring.

### How does a rasp work in rhinoplasty?

works like a file, gently filing down rough edges and contouring the bone to achieve a smoother,
more aesthetically pleasing nose shape.

### What is a cautery device used for in rhinoplasty?

blood loss and helps maintain a clear surgical field, which is important for precision and safety.

### How does a speculum aid in rhinoplasty surgery?

view and access to the nasal cavity during surgery. It helps in visualizing internal nasal
structures for precise adjustments.

### What is the function of a surgical rongeur in rhinoplasty?

A rongeur is used for removing or trimming bone or cartilage. It has sharp, curved jaws that help
with cutting and shaping structures, especially when reducing or sculpting the nasal bones during
the procedure.

### Are there any special instruments for cartilage grafting in rhinoplasty?

Yes, special instruments are used for cartilage grafting. These tools help shape and implant
cartilage from other areas (e.g., the septum, ear, or rib) to provide structural support or enhance
the nasal appearance. They are used to carefully harvest and place the grafts.

### How long does it take to complete a rhinoplasty procedure?

The length of a rhinoplasty surgery can vary depending on the complexity of the procedure. On
average, it takes about 1.5 to 3 hours, though it may take longer if additional procedures, such as
cartilage grafting or septoplasty, are involved.

### Why is surgical suction necessary during rhinoplasty?

Surgical suction is used to remove blood, fluids, or debris from the surgical area. This ensures the
surgeon has a clear view of the nasal structures, which is crucial for precise and safe surgery.

### What kind of aftercare is required after rhinoplasty?

After rhinoplasty, patients typically need to rest and avoid any strenuous activities for several
weeks. Nasal packing or splints may be used temporarily, and follow-up appointments are important to
monitor healing. Swelling and bruising are common, and pain management is part of post-operative
care.

### Are there risks involved with using surgical instruments in rhinoplasty?

As with any surgery, there are potential risks, including infection, scarring, excessive bleeding,
or damage to the nasal structures. However, skilled surgeons use these instruments with great care,
and complications are rare when proper procedures are followed.

### Do all surgeons use the same instruments for rhinoplasty?

Most surgeons use a similar set of instruments, but there may be slight variations depending on the
surgeon’s preferences, the type of rhinoplasty (open vs. closed), and the complexity of the
procedure. Some surgeons may also use advanced technology like endoscopes in specific cases.
